notes.title: Update 1.1.3 Changelog
notes.content:
- Added more SA-TA's to Galaxy Crossed levels that were overlooked, and fixed some of her dialogue
- Added missing apostrophes (would you believe me that this was a game maker issue and not a grammatical one)
- [b]NERFED DARK EFFECTS [/b]-- no more dynamic lighting in favor of not murdering computers, new effect is just a dark vignette on the screen
- fixed broken collision on cardboard floors
- fixed a bunch of grammatical errors
- edges of grass alts and slopes fixed
- wrote a failsafe code to make sure characters are unlocked with their respective achievements (and should retroactively work for those who are missing characters)
- Added subtitles for Purceus, Malloc, ToeJam, and Earl (Remedy and Frallan dont have voices, so, uh...)
- fixed orb indicator appears over dialogue boxes
- fixed Stumps and Dead Trees appear below adjacent fences
- In rare instances, the orb can get stuck in a pseudo-falling state and ignore pitfalls while the orb's image displaces itself. I THINK I know the problem and MAY have fixed it, but this bug is impossible to replicate so I dunno if it's actually been fixed.
- Fixed some music desyncing?
- Level Fixes:[list]
[*] X1-5: Fixed a misaligned booster pad
[*] X1-3: Added more yellow pistons because half the level was skippable
[*] X3-1: Fixed the tile the black goal is on so it doesn't trap the orb
[*] X4-1: Added tiles to prevent the orb from softlocking, also added a little more to hint at how to get the Sun Seal

notes.title: Wonder Wickets 1.0.12 Changelog
notes.content:
Happy April 1st everyone! I hope all of you have a great day full of goofs and gaffs! As for Wonder Wickets, it's all business over here.. nothing different or strange at all! This update finally transfers all of the changes found in the nebula build into the main branch of the game. Thanks to all who had helped test and find issues with the run of the nebula branch! In addition to this, there have been minor UI related fixes made. Be sure to report any bugs you may find in the comments or on the forums! And while you're at it, apparently one of the [url=https://twitter.com/RCatkus]Catki made their way onto Twitter...[/url] somehow?

[b][i]Wonder Wickets 1.0.12 Update[/i][/b]
[i]New Additions:[/i]
[list]
[*] Added the ability to cancel your swing after confirming power
[*] Added the ability to import save data from latest demo version
[*] Added new error handling screen along with bug reporting
[/list]

[i]Changes Made:[/i]
[list]
[*] Changed “Beta Version” to “Version” in debug overlay
[*] Helped Pyxis find a comfier pillow to sleep on
[*] Edited and updated parts of the credits 
[*] Deleted some random Catki thorns found in the game's files
[*] Changed and fixed some misleading/misspelled text
[*] Changed and updated some loadscreen text
[*] Changed copyright information for game executable
[*] Changed version number to denote “(N)ebula” and “(C)ompiled” builds
[*] Increased size of workshop menu
[*] Added Freen in Green logo to intro
[*] Updated goodies menu button icons

[*] Added additional credits
[/list]

[i]Bugs Fixed:[/i]

[u]Due to compatiblity issues, the macOS release of the game will come at a later date. Information on this will be posted soon. Thank you for understanding![/u]

notes.title: Wonder Wickets Nebula Changelog
notes.content:
[b][u]UPDATE: This post has been changed to feature all Nebula changes![/u][/b]

Long time no see, eh? Well it's been quite a while since our last update, but we've finally got one cooked up and almost ready to go! Note that I say almost, this is because we'll be doing things a bit differently this time around. As you may have noticed in the title, this is going to be the first official release of the Wonder Wickets [b]Nebula[/b] build! Don't be alarmed though, this is an entirely opt-in version of Wonder Wickets specially made for beta testing! Preview newly introduced bug fixes, changes, potentially new bugs, and even the pre-release [b]macOS build[/b]! Help contribute to development by testing these builds and posting about them here on the Steam forums or in the official [url=https://discord.gg/bCkUtgs]Discord server[/url]! To try out the Wonder Wickets Nebula build, go to your game library in the Steam Client, right-click on Wonder Wickets and select "Properties", go to the "BETAS" tab, and select the "nebula" branch. Allow Steam to download the new build and then enjoy the beta! Just know that due to the nature of these Nebula builds, updates may be pushed/reverted without notice and you may encounter more bugs than usual in these builds! Be sure to use the newly implemented *in-game bug reporting to report any bugs you encounter. 
* [u]In-game error reporting is only available on Windows[/u]

notes.title: Wonder Wickets 1.0.11 Changelog
notes.content:
Huh, it’s been quite a while since the last update hasn’t it? Well with time comes… a lot of changes and fixes! We’ve been working on the bugs you all have reported to make sure that the game is an enjoyable experience for you! With this update we bring balance changes to Stardust, new and improved texture loading to make the game load speedy fast, and better data management options to make sure you don’t accidentally delete your data or anything…!

[b][i]Wonder Wickets 1.0.11 Update[/i][/b]
[i]Changes Made:[/i]
[list]
[*]Texture loading will now only load character textures at the start of the game, rather than every time you go to the main menu
[list]
	[*]This should improve level and menu load times dramatically
[/list]
[*]Made achievements regarding secret levels more clear
[*]Rebalanced Stardust Versus
[list]
	[*]20 undeposited stardust = 1 point
	[*]10 deposited stardust = 1 point 
[*]Data management menu moved to Goodies
	[*]Selectively delete campaign medals, all campaign progress, or all data
[/list]
[*]Removed rogue water tile on Pipedream
[*]Added “Texture Scale” option to video options to allow for changing the scale at which textures are loaded into video memory
[*]Added “Texture Filter” option to video options to allow for disabling the smoothing filter applied to textures
[*]Workshop completion rate will now display “0% (0/0)” instead of “0%” if no completions submitted
[*]Improved “Discord Presence” popup text in options menu
[*]Levels are marked as complete when both players complete the level in level level editor
[*]Nova’s cuteness nerfed to balance with other characters
[*]All orbs hand-polished back to sparkling like-new condition
[/list]

[i]Bugs Fixed:[/I]
[list]
[*]Fixed camera not correctly following players in online versus
[*]Fixed black screen on loading screen when first launching the game
[*]Fixed exploit that allowed player 2 in local versus to infinitely use powerup
[*]Fixed crash when viewing workshop levels with incorrectly loaded icons in versus level select
[*]Fixed Rocket powerup for peers in online versus
[*]Fixed crash at the end of an online versus match
[*]Fixed powerups being assigned to the wrong player in online versus
[*]Fixed crash caused by joining a lobby which is on a different version
[*]Removed debug text from displaying on workshop level view
[*]Level uploading text is no longer covered by other alert text in level editor
[*]Fixed crash when cancelling the “Load from PNG” dialog in the level editor’s startup screen
[*]Fixed paint not correctly covering rotatable tiles
[/list]

[i]Notes:[/i]
[list]
[*]Scoring changes may not be reflected in online versus yet
[/list]

As always, thank you for playing and be sure to join the [url=http://discord.gg/bCkUtgs]official Wonder Wickets Discord server[/url] and report any bugs you might find! (Unless said bug is Nova, she’s alright! :slynova:)

notes.title: Wonder Wickets 1.0.SPOOKY Changelog
notes.content:
You know what time it is? That's right, it's time to get spooky! Launch up Wonder Wickets on the frightful night to discover what tricks (or treats!) we have in store for you! Have a happy halloween, wicketeers!

[b]Wonder Wickets 1.0.SPOOKY updates:[/b]
[i]General Updates:[/i]
+ Halloween!

[i]Level Updates:[/i]
- Classic: Downhill Slam (added Specs and locked up orbs so new players can figure out how to use recall pads)
- Classic: Four Corners Two (fully rebuilt)
- Stardust: Forest Forrage (minor changes)

[i]New Levels:[/i]
- Stardust: Downhill Jam
- Stardust: Star Splash
- Stardust: Hedge Find
- Conquest: Blockade Raid

[i]Removed Levels:[/i]
- Stardust: Sparkling Star Shores
- Stardust: Deciduous Belts

[i]Misc Changes & Fixes:[/i]
- Lighting is now shader based and less demanding on systems with integrated graphics
- Textures are now loaded properly between transition screens, decreasing memory usage and fixes stuttering in areas where large amounts of textures are loaded
- Discord Rich Presence information has been improved to be more descriptive about your current state.
- You can now load PNG levels that you saved previously created (NOTE: only newly saved levels can be loaded through this method)
- Steam Workshop subscriptions now await Steam stats to be loaded, fixing missing names and or thumbnails
- The top score text on the workshop level view now fits to the GUI
- Workshop completion rate now gives an amount of attempts along with a proper percentage
- “Encounter of the First Kind” achievement will now unlock properly
- “Some Kind of Sabotage” achievement will now unlock properly
- An improved “BETA” watermark is now persistently displayed in online multiplayer, giving information about the user and current version
- macOS now properly supports Steamworks features

[i]Notes:[/i]
- This update [b]does not[/b] include changes and fixes to online multiplayer, as the existing changes were not suitable for release yet.

notes.title: Wonder Wickets 1.0.5 + 1.0.6 Changelogs
notes.content:
Wonder Wickets 1.0.5:
Bug Fixes:
- Softlock when non-controlling player's orb lands in hole (local versus)

Level Fixes:
- 7-* moved rocket powerup so it doesn't explode immediately
- 3-6 placed clouds under moon medal to prevent crash
- 6-* Added yellow pistons to make use of leftover yellow lever, removed a few useless blocks
- VS Rolling Down Hills: Removed fences near conveyor belt

--

Wonder Wickets 1.0.6:
Community Levels:
- The workshop level viewer has been redone and now properly sorts by level type
- The loading animation now transitions in properly after playing a custom level
- Fixed a crash where the game would display an error upon returning after playing a custom level
- When playing a custom level, the pause menu says "Return to Community" instead of "Return to Workshop"
- An error message is displayed upon loading an invalid INI file for a level
- You can no longer load any PNG file into Wonder Wickets, an error message will be displayed if invalid
- Fixed custom PNG levels not restarting properly
- You return to the Community Levels menu when returning to the main menu
- Level files will be checked for errors before attempting to load the level
- Versus levels from the workshop are now playable in local versus
- Vote count and completion rate is now displayed on workshop menu
- Global top score for workshop level is now displayed on workshop menu

Level Editor:
- Preload buttons in the level editor can no longer be pressed when a warning is active
- Level editor now lists fill-area and history hotkeys
- You can now update previously uploaded workshop levels in the editor
- Level editor text "Replace Existing Level" changed to "Update Existing Level"
- A notification is now displayed whenever your level is finished uploading to the workshop, this notification also allows you to load the level in the Steam overlay
- A different notification is shown based on if you're uploading or updating a level
- Text is now displayed when a level uploading to workshop is in progress
- Removed debug keybind that opened workshop upload dialogue
- Fixed issue where the map save dialogue would display when selecting "Save Image" for a workshop level
- Workshop upload menu no longer colourizes description
- Fixed tags list display on workshop upload menu
- Checklist now displays when a workshop level is being uploaded

Misc Changes:
- You can now enable safemode by entering "-safemode" as a launch argument for the game to improve lighting performance
- The control display now says "Exit" instead of "exit"
- Adjusted spelling of custom level buttons' text
- Tooltips with incorrect amount of line breaks in Community Levels menu has been accounted for
- You can no longer select Community Levels buttons when a warning is active
- Subtitle text now has semi-transparent backing to improve readability
- Fixed issue where control hint display would be covered by stardust overlay
- Potential fix to framerate being uncapped in fullscreen for high refresh rate displays

notes.title: Wonder Wickets 1.0.1 Changelog
notes.content:
Since we've started getting a few streamers broadcasting the game, we've managed to catch a few more stray bugs and balancing issues. Honestly, since our beta testing team was so small, we're most likely going to be hotfixing for a little while post-release.

If anyone finds any bugs or issues with level design, we have an area to report them on the new Official Wonder Wickets Discord! 

https://discordapp.com/invite/bCkUtgs

Anyways, here's the changes we made for 1.0.1:

Level Fixes:
- Campaign 4-6: Made second half of level a little less difficult, and unlocked the trap door to prevent orb stranding when using the top or bottom pipes.
- Campaign 5-3: Didn't have enough rocket powerup drops for the first stage that introduces them. I swapped out the pickup to be an unlimited source so that new players can have enough to play around with the rockets and how they work.
- Challengoid #4 had an awkward black goal area that was too easy to strand your orb and force level reset. I added slopes to prevent this.

Bug Fixes:
- Completing a challengoid failed to pull the challengoid's name, resulting in the game crashing.
- Selecting "Return to Editor" from the pause menu when testing a VS map instead asked for "both players to agree to restarting level".
- Timer continues running after sinking the orb during Time Attack levels

Miscellaneous:
- Added a link to the Wonder Wickets Discord to the title screen.
